items.title: SNOMED CT UK Drug Extension: grouper concepts being removed, supplier survey closes 20 November 2026
items.summary: NHS England is removing the five grouper concepts from the SNOMED CT UK Drug Extension in Phase 2 of its alignment to the SNOMED International national drug extension model, scheduled for Quarter 4 2026, and replacing them with Refsets.

items.title: UKHSA concerned over ‘low uptake’ of pharmacy MenB jab offer
items.summary: Less than one in three eligible 18- and 19-year-olds have had a first dose of the free MenB vaccine which is currently being offered in pharmacies. The UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) said this meant more than 580,000 students in this age group had not yet come forward. The government agency said it was concerned...

items.title: ICB refuses to fund GPs for transitioning patients from discontinued Levemir
items.summary: One ICB has rejected a proposal from GP leaders seeking funding for practices switching patients from Levemir (insulin detemir) to alternatives.

items.title: NHSE sets out requirements for pharmacy prescribing including GP communication
items.summary: NHS England has set out requirements for pharmacies delivering prescribing services, including sending GP practices information on all prescribing activity.

items.title: Pharmacies can begin providing new NHS prescribing services
items.summary: Approved community pharmacies can start delivering five new prescribing pathways announced under this year's Community Pharmacy contractual framework (Google Alert, The Pharmacist).

items.title: Joint GP and community pharmacy conference to return for 2027 in London
items.summary: GPs and community pharmacy professionals are invited to a free-to-attend conference in London next June which aims to bring the two groups together to collaborate as the Government aims to shift care out of hospital.

items.title: Community Pharmacy and General Practice Conference returns in 2027
items.summary: Primary care nursing professionals will have the opportunity to explore how closer working between general practice and community pharmacy can improve patient care at the second annual Community Pharmacy and General Practice Conference, which moves to London in 2027.
